datasets.title: Moldova: High Resolution Population Density Maps + Demographic Estimates
datasets.description: The world's most accurate population datasets. Seven maps/datasets for the distribution of various populations in Moldova: (1) Overall population density (2) Women (3) Men (4) Children (ages 0-5) (5) Youth (ages 15-24) (6) Elderly (ages 60+) (7) Women of reproductive age (ages 15-49).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/moldova-high-resolution-population-density-maps-demographic-estimates]
datasets.details: To reference this data, please use the following citation: Facebook Connectivity Lab and Center for International Earth Science Information Network - CIESIN - Columbia University. 2016. High Resolution Settlement Layer (HRSL). Source imagery for HRSL © 2016 DigitalGlobe. Accessed DAY MONTH YEAR.' Please note that as of 2024, Meta's high resolution population density maps are no longer being updated.

creator.name: AI and Data for Good at Meta

lineage.description: High-resolution population density maps were created by applying machine learning algorithms to commercially available satellite imagery to identify building footprints, then overlaying population estimates derived from census data and demographic statistics in partnership with Columbia University. The resulting gridded datasets provide spatial distribution of total population and demographic subgroups at fine resolution for disaster risk exposure assessment.

sources.name: Facebook
sources.description: Satellite imagery and machine learning-based building identification used to create high-resolution population distribution maps

sources.name: Columbia University
sources.description: Population estimation methodology based on census data and publicly available demographic statistics overlaid on building footprints
